chat_log_search.description: Read-only literal search and attachment filtering of saved chat messages and anchored reasoning excerpts.
rules: Use CHAT_LOG_SEARCH to search messages or attachments using date range!
query is optional, omit query to search filter-only. has_attachments=true filters for messages that contain one or more attached files.
source=user searches only USER text. source=['user','jin'] includes JIN text and reasoning for text searches.
